headline: Public hearings in cases involving tenants and landlords at 90 Gridley Street and 28 Spring Street.
summary: Two hearings are listed, one involving Joseph and Eric Testman and Marieanne St. Germain, and one involving Halima Butler Farnsworth and Thomas C. Zipp. Other business includes old and new business, meeting dates, and public participation.
items: Hearing on 90 Gridley Street, Bristol, with tenants Joseph and Eric Testman and landlord Marieanne St. Germain
Hearing on 28 Spring Street, Bristol, with tenant Halima Butler Farnsworth and landlord Thomas C. Zipp
Meeting dates and agendas, including the next meeting on December 16, 2026 at 6:00 PM
location: Bristol City Hall, 111 N. Main Street, 3rd floor, Rooms 3-1, 3-2, 3-3, Bristol, Connecticut
plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
 
City of Bristol 
Bristol, Connecticut 
 
FAIR RENT COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
 The Fair Rent Commission will hold a regular meeting on Wednesday, November 
18, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Bristol City Hall, 111 N. Main Street, 3rd floor, Rooms 3-1,3-2,3-3, 
Bristol, Connecticut. 
 
AGENDA 
1. Call to order 
2. Introduction of commissioners. 
3. Seating of alternates. 
4. Discussion and approval of the minutes of October 28, 2026 and take any action 
as necessary. 
5. Hearing(s) in the matters of: 
a. Joseph and Eric Testman (Tenants) and Marieanne St. Germain 
(Landlord) 90 Gridley Street, Bristol, Connecticut. 
b. Halima Butler Farnsworth (Tenant) and Thomas C. Zipp (Landlord)  
28 Spring Street, Bristol, Connecticut 
6. Discussion by commissioners of old business and take any action as necessary. 
7. Discussion by commissioners of new business and take any action as necessary. 
8. Discussion by commissioners of meeting dates and agendas and take any action 
as necessary. 
a. Next Meeting: December 16, 2026 at 6:00 PM, City Hall. 
9. Public participation 
10.  Adjournment. 
 
/s/ Anthony Lozier 
Per Anthony Lozier, Chairman 
DATED: November 17, 2026
Page 2 of 2
